subject: #223 baseline hygiene: audited re-bless of the two stale baselines + taken-at provenance stamp
description:
First item of the next Opus session (ruled docs/fable-answers-s339.md §5a/§5b). Two sessions of "+8 / 2 fixed" drift must not reach three.

Procedure (honours "never re-bless from a run" where it applies):
1. fail-baseline.tsv: remove the two scalar.t FIXED rows by EDITING them out, naming the s333 fix that made them pass in the commit. Never save-regenerated.
2. pass-baseline.tsv: generated file, so re-bless IS the mechanism — but only from a gate-green run after a per-file audit: diff the run's _status.tsv against docs/pass-baseline.tsv; every changed file must have a named cause and no file may have gone DOWN. The +8 must be fully attributed (scalar.t +2 plus the owner of the other 6) BEFORE save-status runs; an unexplained delta is a finding, stop.
3. sweep-diff.pl save-status writes a "# taken-at: <sha> <date>" header; diff/LOST reader skip # lines. Remember NUL bytes: grep -a or perl on these files.

Then start E4.1 per docs/v2-opus5-execution-plan.md §5.
activeForm: Re-blessing the stale baselines with audit + provenance stamp
